protocol_notes: All 10 observed noisy realizations are evaluated as independent 7-frame sequences; the paper's exact selection is unconfirmed.
GBRG is packed as R,G(top-left),B,G(bottom-right); this is a local adapter contract, not a verified MSTMN channel mapping.
Black/white levels come from CRVD authors; clipping, warm-up, SSIM and aggregation choices need confirmation against official MSTMN code.
Adapters must reset recurrent state per scene/ISO/noisy realization and own initialization, memory, flow and noise coefficient conversion.
Metrics use normalized Bayer mosaics; Table III comparison remains provisional. No ISP or sRGB evaluation is provided.
